notes: Gamepad: menu icon tron doc, nhan do, nut an/hien nut da ghim, bao nut chua gan phim, da diem cham. Phong to man nho (doi ten kinh lup): ghim bang Alt, tieu de STT-serial-IP. Cu chi cuon: cuon=vuot may, Shift=cuon luoi, Ctrl=phong to, Ctrl+Shift=doi co o. Them 2 co o nho + nut '!' tro giup tung chuc nang (du 7 ngon ngu). Giai ma: them che do 'Can bang CPU+GPU' tu chia tai theo so nhan CPU (Xeon nhieu nhan uu tien CPU, may yeu offload GPU). TWRP: xoay ngang tuy chon, sua dieu khien may thao man (988e) + warm phien recovery. Them Xoa clip / Tim kiem vao panel. Chong sua file: tu kiem chu ky Authenticode.
